Describe the higher-level problem shared by all pillars.
All three pillars work together to bridge the gap between perceiving massive unstructured data in physical environments and executing real-time autonomous decisions in digital workflows.
Describe the boundary of each of the three directions.

HEALTH: Strictly focuses on physiological data and clinical predictive modeling; does not handle general vision.EDGE-AI: Focuses on hardware-constrained, high-frequency visual processing; does not handle deep NLP logic.AGENT: Focuses on NLP, RAG knowledge bases, and conversational UI; does not handle raw sensor/hardware integration.
Explain how the three pillars connect and reuse one another.

EDGE-AI serves as the perception layer, capturing environmental or physical data at high speeds on constrained hardware. For biomedical scenarios, this data is passed to HEALTH algorithms for deep pathological or risk analysis. Finally, AGENT acts as the orchestration layer, synthesizing quantitative outputs from Edge and Health models into natural language advice or automated workflows (e.g., Digital Concierge or AI Coaching) for human end-users.

rows: Describe the key method and applicable conditions.

We treat Skills as compilable natural-language programs. Based on the capability profiles of models, Agent frameworks, and host environments, we perform ahead-of-time (AOT) adaptation, dependency binding, concurrent workflow orchestration, and runtime feedback optimization, while retaining version rollback capability.
Describe the specific advantage and applicability boundaries.

Reduces repetitive rewrites, blind retries, and environment failures when migrating Skills across models and frameworks, making task success rates, latency, token consumption, and failure causes easier to track and optimize.
Describe the key method and applicable conditions.

We separate conversational working memory, structured long-term memory, and the proactive suggestion layer. Rule-based routing, explicit associations, source records, expiry reviews, and deletion mechanisms are combined to manage the lifecycle of memory storage, retrieval, and removal.
Describe the specific advantage and applicability boundaries.

Reduces the need for users to repeat information while keeping sources traceable, content editable, permissions controllable, and expired memories removable. If long-term memory is unavailable, the system can still fall back to a standard single-session conversation.
Describe the key method and applicable conditions.

We reuse logits produced by the supervised fine-tuning forward pass and apply the nuclear norm to estimate sample utility and within-sample diversity. Low-dimensional representations and a historical buffer then identify redundancy across samples, enabling online selection of data that is more valuable for parameter updates.
Describe the specific advantage and applicability boundaries.

Prioritizes backpropagation for high-value, non-redundant samples, increasing the density of effective updates within a fixed training budget and reducing the compute and time wasted on repeatedly training with homogeneous data.

说明共同面向的上位问题。
三大研究支柱协同工作，打通物理环境中海量非结构化数据的感知与数字工作流中实时自主决策执行之间的链路。
分别说明三个方向的边界。
HEALTH： 专注生理数据与临床预测建模，不处理通用视觉任务。EDGE-AI： 专注硬件受限条件下的高频视觉处理，不处理深层自然语言处理逻辑。AGENT： 专注自然语言处理、RAG 知识库和对话式用户界面，不处理原始传感器或硬件集成。
说明三者的连接复用关系。
EDGE-AI 作为感知层，在受限硬件上高速采集环境或物理数据。在生物医学场景中，这些数据会传递给 HEALTH 算法，进行深入的病理或风险分析。最后，AGENT 作为编排层，将边缘模型和健康模型的量化输出整合为面向最终用户的自然语言建议或自动化工作流（如数字礼宾或人工智能健康指导）。
